_note: Public rules. Each word is a regex, matched as a whole word, ignoring case. In 'lists', order matters: the first list with a match wins. '_doc' is copied into results/0_definitions.md; {name} is filled with that setting's value.

unit._doc: One message typed by the user. Excluded: session summaries, interruption markers, commands, and pastes (more than {paste_words} words, or starting with: {greeting}).

session._doc: A new session starts after a gap of more than {gap_minutes} minutes. Sessions with fewer than {min_messages} messages are dropped from session-level tests.

domain._doc: The first list with a matching word sets the domain. No match: the domain of the previous message (within the session gap), else Unclassified. Groups: {groups}.

output_type._doc: The first list with a matching word sets the type. No match: the type of the previous message (within the session gap), else Text.

tone._doc: Both lists match: Mixed. One list matches: that tone. No match: Neutral. A dissatisfied message has tone: {dissatisfied}.

reply._doc: Prompt and reply: each prompt (an included message, or a paste, because the agent received that text) is paired with the user's next included message, if it comes within the session gap. The reply's tone group (Dissatisfied, Satisfied, or Neutral) shows how the agent's work on that prompt was received.

limits._doc: Word matching misses sarcasm and indirect complaints. Private word lists (names, organizations) are kept local and are not shown here.
